name: Rag Time ~Kimi no Tame no Shijuusou~
original_name: ラグタイム ~君のための四重奏~
source:
Yuu and Shinji are childhood friends. Due to family circumstances, Yuu has to run the guesthouse on her own, and Shinji helps her out. Then, two beautiful twins appear before them...

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070430073018/http://g.eaa.jp/rag/rstory.htm]official site[/url]]
translation:
优与慎二是青梅竹马。由于家庭变故，优不得不独自一人打理民宿，慎二便在旁帮忙照应。就在这时，一对貌美如花的双胞胎出现在了两人面前……

[译自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070430073018/http://g.eaa.jp/rag/rstory.htm]官方网站[/url]]
